project_type: MERN stack (MongoDB + Express + React + Node.js) food redistribution platform with Socket.IO
language: JavaScript (ES6+) with JSX for React components
build_system: npm workspaces - server uses nodemon for development, client uses Vite build tool
test_framework: No specific test framework mentioned in documentation - manual testing approach
build_command: npm run dev (runs both server and client concurrently)
test_command: Manual testing workflow - server on port 5000, client on port 5173
verification_instructions: 1. Start server (cd server && npm run dev), 2. Start client (cd client && npm run dev), 3. Test features in browser, 4. Verify real-time functionality across multiple browser tabs
environment_constraints: Server runs on port 5000, client on port 5173. MongoDB connection required (local or Atlas). Socket.IO for real-time features.
contribution_requirements: Based on project docs - clean MVC architecture, security best practices, responsive design, real-time Socket.IO integration
key_patterns: JWT authentication, Mongoose models, Express controllers with error handling, React functional components with hooks, Tailwind CSS styling, Socket.IO rooms for user/role targeting
directory_structure: Root level: server/ and client/ directories. Server: src/controllers, src/routes, src/models, src/services, src/middleware. Client: src/pages, src/components, src/context, src/services. Static file serving from server/uploads/ directory.
